description:

description:

description:

description:

description:
S02 E05 — Pups Save a Ghost; Pups Save a Show

description:

The Mini Patrol and the Pups race to save a mural before it rains; Farmer Al and Yumi discover their garden is full of holes and their one-of-a-kind potato is missing.

title: PAW Patrol
description:

Ryder surprises the pups with a new mobile lookout so they can save the day outside of Adventure Bay; Jake gets lost in the South Pole.

title: PAW Patrol
description:

The pups leap into action when Digi and Tal's coconut catapult goes rampant and rockets off through the jungle targeting birds and monkeys.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S12 E13 — Pups Save the Hum-Sprayer; Pups Save the Hot Springs
Mayor Humdinger makes a mess when he steals paint from Rubble's cousin Mix; two mountain goats cause trouble at adventure bay's hot springs.

description:

When the Ruff-Ruff Pack steals Mr. Porter's mini-donut maker, the Moto Pups set off to get the machine back in one piece; the Ruff-Ruff Pack takes over Humdinger's lair and runs off with his kitties.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S09 E07 — Pups Save the Tooth Fairy; Pups Solve the Mystery of the Missing Art
Julius loses his tooth and has a dream that the PAW Patrol saves a bumbling tooth fairy; when all the paintings mysteriously disappear from the Art Museum Festival, the PAW Patrol must solve the missing art mystery and return all the paintings.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S09 E26 — Charger Visits the Pups; Pups Save a Shiny Ride
Rubble's cousin Charger visits Adventure Bay just in time to help out when a Humdinger-caused geyser destroys Mr. Porter's café; Mayor Humdinger hatches a plan to sabotage the Shiniest Ride Contest, so it's up to the PAW Patrol to save the day.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
Aqua Pups Save a Floating Castle; Aqua Pups Save the Reef; Aqua Pups Stop a Giant Squid; Aqua Pups Save a Mer-Race; Aqua Pups Save a Merdinger
Moby wants to clear all the Merpups out of Puplantis and make the castle his own; the PAW Patrol is there to stop his soggy schemes with help from a new Cockapoo Merpup named Coral.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S07 E05 — Pups Save a Waiter-Bot; Pups Stop a Pie-Clone
Mr. Porter's new high-tech waiter robot helps around the café, but it can't stop cleaning; it's up to the pups to clean up the mess; Mayor Humdinger creates a cyclone of delicious pies, and the pups must stop it before the town is covered.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S10 E23 — Rescue Wheels: Pups Save Adventure Bay
Two competitive truckers come to town for a monster truck rally, one of them befriends the pups, the other stirs up lots of trouble.

title: PAW Patrol
description:

Just as the PAW Patrol is about to help Farmer Al capture his runaway pigs, Chase, Zuma and Skye all become sick; when lunches start disappearing at an old miner's cabin in the woods, the PAW Patrol comes to investigate.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S07 E08 — Dino Rescue: Pups Save a Hum-Dino
Mayor Humdinger and his Kitties go to Dino Wilds for Dino acting lessons but somehow find themselves bound for Adventure Bay.

title: PAW Patrol
description:

title: PAW Patrol
description:

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S09 E06 — Big Truck Pups Stop a Flood
The PAW Patrol uses its new big trucks and the help of new pup pal Al to repair a dam before Adventure Bay is flooded.

description:

Rubble dreams that he's been taken aboard a spaceship and meets his alien double; the Pups must save Humdinger and his kittens when they mess around with Blinky the Clown's tiny clown car.

description:

Yumi's new Robo-Corn Plucker goes haywire; Ryder and the "PAW Patrol" must get it under control; Daring Danny X, dressed as a "Bird X" mascot, gets carried away by a couple of eagles.

description:

description:

Gil embarks on an icy expedition to the North Pole.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:

Police Officers Molly and Gil are tracking some mysterious lights that have been popping up around town; with the help of several nocturnal animal friends, they discover the lights aren't aliens but anglerfish.

description:

title: Team Umizoomi
description:

Milli, Geo and Bot play carnival games to earn tickets and help a boy win a special prize.

description:

Mayor Goodway asks the PAW Patrol to rescue her twin niece and nephew from a tree; Mayor Goodway receives a package of piglets instead of the fireworks she was expecting.

title: PAW Patrol
description:

Liberty comes to visit the pups just in time to help save the Turbots and their radar Doppler in a daring mountain rescue; when Farmer Al builds a windmill, the wind takes Farmer Yumi and Garby on a wild flight.

description:
S09 E04 — Cat Pack/PAW Patrol Rescue: The Cat That Roared; Cat Pack/PAW Patrol Rescue: Saving the Safe
Leo and Rory join the PAW Patrol on a visit to the jungle; they end up rescuing a baby monkey; when Mayor Humdinger rebuilds Meow Meow to break into Mayor Goodway's new safe, the Cat Pack joins the PAW Patrol to save the day.

description:
S01 E02 — The Crew Builds a Big Bike Shop; The Crew Builds a Super Tub
Rubble and the pups work to build a big bike shop in time for the Bike Festival, unless Speed Meister beats them to it; when Motor won't take a bath before their family photo, it's up to Rubble and the pups to find a construction solution.

title: Rubble & Crew
description:
S06 E601 — The Crew Builds a Giant Halloween Pumpkin
Rubble moves with his family of construction pups to the nearby town of Builder Cove where they live, play and build whatever the community needs.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S09 E15 — Pups Save a T-Rex Tyke; Pups Save a Playful Elephant Calf
When a baby T. rex gets lost, Ryder and the pups go on a mission to the Dino Wilds to help find him; when Everest joins the PAW Patrol for a visit to the jungle, she makes friends with a clumsy elephant calf and then must help rescue him.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S06 E17 — Pups Save the Bears; Pups Save a Farmerless Farm
The PAW Patrol works quietly to save sleeping bears and return them to their cave; with the farmers out of town, Mayor Goodway calls the PAW Patrol to wrangle animals and control the chaos on a farmerless farm.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S06 E05 — Ultimate Rescue: Pups Save the Mountain Climbers; Ultimate Rescue: Pup Save Captain Gordy
Rubble leads the pups in building an emergency landing pad for Captain Gordy; Mayor Goodway, Danny and the Turbots are stuck in a canyon in the mountains.

title: PAW Patrol
description:

Liberty mistakenly brings a bear into town, thinking it's someone's pet; she must fix her mistake and rescue Chickaletta; Francois' hot-air balloon goes out of control before the Pup Pup Boogie Contest; the Pups, with Liberty, race to the rescue.

description:

title: Bubble Guppies

The Bubble Guppies go sightseeing in the big city.

description:

Everyone in the Old West town of Harmony Valley loves playing music together; when noisy Billy Joe Strumlouder rides into town to sabotage their tunes, Sheriff Zooli must save the day.

description:

Gil and his friends attend a basketball game played by elephants.

description:

description:

description:

Robot Mechanic Molly and Robo Puppy must stop a bossy cyborg named the Glitch when it hacks all the robots in Robotopolis and forces them to dance "The Robot."

title: Bubble Guppies
description:

The Guppies help a friendly pirate search for treasure using a map.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:

The Bubble Guppies fly an airplane through the sky.

description:

Gil and his team of firefighters must rescue another firefighter who is stuck in a tree.
